title: Docs: CI/CD & Gates SSOT (PF + generated products) - triggers, tiers, gates, delivery, text+Mermaid diagrams
body:
## Goal & value
One SSOT for how PF builds/verifies/ships and for generated products: trigger map, author-time hooks,
precheck tiers, PR merge gate, delivery lane, CI job, release; plus the non-CI gates run with local work and
the generated-product CI model. Registered in the docs index.

## Deliverable
`docs/CI-CD-AND-GATES-SSOT.md` (diagrams at top: plain-text + 3 Mermaid; then Parts A-D).

## Acceptance
- Doc exists + classified (docs-fresh OK, gen_docs_index no unclassified).
- References (not duplicates) the detail docs (BRANCHING/EOS/REVIEW-MODEL/ENG-5..10).
